children.game_version: The 'Stick-Pass Circle': Children hold colorful sticks in a half-circle, trying not to drop the stick while taking steady half-foot steps and jumping together on count 2.

seniors.seated_version: Seated in a semi-circle, participants hold a lightweight dowel or stick between them horizontally, tapping heels and toes in 2/4 rhythm without jumping.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the half-circle formation holding sticks with full feet on the floor instead of half-feet, replacing jumps with gentle knee flexes.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo, eliminating elevation and strict half-foot balance demands.

learning_units.description: Horizontal stick hold in half-circle line formation.
Steady half-foot stepping and turning mechanics in 2/4 meter.

social_formats.description: Group line dance in a half-circle formation linked by horizontal sticks.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands raised in a horizontal position holding a stick placed between neighboring dancers.
movement_profile.footwork: Steady movements on the half-feet (balls of the feet) with turns and jumps.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Half-circle chain formation traveling along a curved path.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable torso aligned with the rigid horizontal arm line.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Upright elevation on half-feet with mid-level vertical jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: Indirect connection through a wooden stick held between adjacent dancers.
movement_profile.posture: Upright spine with arms held horizontally to grip wooden sticks between dancers.

signature_moves.description: Dancers maintain horizontal hand positions holding shared wooden sticks between them.
signature_moves.name: Stick hold position

signature_moves.description: Turning step executed on the balls of the feet punctuated by a vertical jump.
signature_moves.name: Half-foot turn and jump

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady duple timing with sudden dynamic accents on turns and jumps.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Dropping the horizontal arm line or losing grip on the shared connecting stick.

music_profile.sound_description: A steady, driving 2/4 Balkan folk rhythm designed to support synchronized half-foot steps, turns, and jumps in a line formation.

basic_steps: Form a half-circle line holding a wooden stick horizontally between neighboring dancers.
Execute steady stepping movements weight-centered on the half-feet (balls of the feet).
Perform deliberate turnings around while maintaining the horizontal stick grip.
Incorporate upward jumps coordinated with the 2/4 rhythm.
teaching.formation: Half-circle line connected by sticks held horizontally between dancers
teaching.level_notes: Requires physical balance on the balls of the feet and synchronized upper-body tension while holding intermediary sticks in a group line.
